primary: full GEMM output-ready CUDA graph event span
host_metric: C++ graph submission through synchronized output ready
setup: all calibration, solver, table upload, graph build recorded; no packing
address_model_scope: real split-K partial buffer read and output write latency per SM; no physical NUMA identity or direct SM-to-SM traffic claim
calibration_order: randomized SM and task order; actual producer rerun before each single-SM probe; first of 4 repetitions cold-after-producer, others warm; use median of first repeats over 2 sweeps
mapping_objective: sequential waves of <=56 equal-size chunks; minimize maximum accumulated predicted cycles; exact sum tie-break
sm_only: same assignment compiler using additive per-SM + per-task mean cost
shuffled: same compiler; permuted address columns of residual matrix
inference: process is statistical unit; same-case within-block randomized controls; retain A/A anchors and all timing signs
